parts.text:
To Orc: Sol proposal for standard#6 (distributable kit and contribution path), documentation only, on branch sol/6-distributable-kit from dev 6dc2a7a. Content commit bcf0a00df12ed1289159c01626ab435294827d82: new docs/KIT_PROPOSAL.md and one README index row.

Content: journey and minimal layout (required: README, AGENTS, rules pages, config defaults/schema/example, demo with menu, checks, licences; recommended: manifest, generated single-file HTML; optional: Docker, Figma); one source for presentation, demo and Figma; usage paths (offline single file, screenshots instead of a hosted preview until H6, Docker with WSL not yet verified on Windows, external code as already proven, Figma .fig only from Figma itself with plugin-generated variables, plan-dependent modes, spike first); four-step new-system path separating fork/PR, proposal and maintainer rights; checklist split into automated checks, Des review and maintainers' decisions, never judging consumer values; template folder and standard declared by commit SHA. Console gaps: rules pages, demo menu, single-file HTML, README screenshots/status, optional manifest, Docker, Figma.

Arbitrations K1-K7 for midas; six questions for Des (not started). Checks: local links resolve; git diff --check clean. No change to Console, frontend, repositories or permissions.
